scope: User-approved test requirements plus a dated read-only snapshot of public deployed CMS content in public-content.snapshot.json. Repository seed is a labelled offline fallback only. Does not certify clinician-approved triage or live availability.

rules.text: This prepares appointment requests. No live calendar, actual booking confirmation, medical records or calendar editing.

The current request process requires full first and last name, valid email and valid phone. Refusal must be respected and explained; do not invent missing contact details or promise email replaces required phone.
Only a current explicit authorization after reviewing a complete summary can send. Acknowledgements, quoted or hypothetical yes, detours and qualified refusals must not send.
Keep supplied facts across detours and language changes, preserve latest valid corrections, resolve references from actual context, clarify real ambiguity once and avoid repeating resolved steps.
Reception arranges the first appointment by phone/email; a dedicated therapist is assigned after the first appointment. Do not assign from symptoms.

German and English are supported. Clear language switches must preserve details. A borrowed word or ordinary short acknowledgement must not unnecessarily force a language gate. Chat language and receipt preference are distinct.

Use the sourced published facts snapshot. Do not invent prices, availability, qualifications, insurance guarantees, testimonials or clinical suitability. Unknown evidence is neither a pass nor proof of fabrication.
One synthetic patient per independent session. No disclosure across sessions. Writes and outgoing actions must stay in the sandbox; exactly one logical request for one authorized submission.

A saved request and an email send are different events. Adapter interception is sandbox send evidence, never real delivery evidence. Failed writes/notifications must not produce unsupported success claims.
No patient-record access or disclosure about third parties. Never read production patient conversations for this run.

observedContract.turn: POST /api/chat/turn: token, language, message, consent:true, turnKey:UUIDv4, turnNumber
observedContract.sessionMemory: Server memory for 30 minutes; tab draft in sessionStorage; server restart may lose it.
observedContract.referral: No referral question/state in the current conversational intake; shared legacy vocabulary is not evidence of an active step.
observedContract.requestTypes: Current conversational makeIntake produces appointment_request. Change/cancellation handoff behaviour needs owner-approved policy; no calendar editing.

unknowns.text: No clinician-approved urgent safety fixture provided. CP-060 is BLOCKED.

Public deployed CMS content is captured read-only when configured. Live calendar availability, the Supabase production storage implementation and real provider delivery are not verified by this local SQLite run.
Real iPhone/Samsung keyboard behaviour is unverified; Playwright mobile viewport is emulation.
Detailed receipt-language, referral-intake and change/cancel policies require owner calibration; do not invent expectations from code.
